production.note: US model years 2002-2005, the 2.0-liter 227 hp WRX. Start: Subaru of America's release 'Subaru Announces Pricing on 2002 Model Year WRX Sedan and WRX Sport Wagon' (January 9, 2001; cars 'will reach Subaru dealerships in early Spring 2001'). 2003: Cars.com lists the 2003 '4dr Sdn WRX Manual' at 227 hp (cars-com-wrx-2003). The facelifted 2004-2005 cars kept the same engine and rating, so they belong to this record (data guide: a facelift is not a separate car): KBB 2005 WRX Sport Wagon "227 @ 6000 RPM", "4-Cyl, Turbo, 2.0 Liter" (kbb-impreza-2005). End: KBB 2006 lists the WRX with "230 @ 5600 RPM" and "4-Cyl, Turbo, 2.5 Liter" (kbb-impreza-2006), a different engine.

body.note: 'All WRX sedan and WRX Sport Wagon models feature full-time All-Wheel Drive.' The standard car here is the sedan.

configuration.note: Subaru boxer four; the release describes a '2.0 liter 227-horsepower turbocharged and intercooled engine'.

displacementL.note: '2.0 liter'; Carey Russ: 'Engine Size 2.0 liters / 122cu. in.' (theautochannel-wrx-2002-russ). No cc figure was found on an opened page.

transmission.note: 'The standard manual transmission uses a viscous coupling locking center differential All-Wheel Drive system'; 'The optional four-speed electronic automatic transmission (4EAT)'. Five speeds: Carey Russ, 'Transmission 5-speed manual' (theautochannel-wrx-2002-russ); Cars.com '5-Speed M/T' (cars-com-wrx-2002).

powerHp.note: Quote (Subaru of America release): "2.0 liter 227-horsepower turbocharged and intercooled engine". Carey Russ: "Horsepower 227 @ 6000rpm" (theautochannel-wrx-2002-russ); Cars.com 2002 and 2003 '4dr Sdn WRX Manual': "227 @ 6000" (cars-com-wrx-2002, cars-com-wrx-2003).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (single article and database). 2002 WRX sedan, 5-speed manual. Quote (Carey Russ, The Auto Channel, spec panel): "Curb Weight 3085 lbs." Cars.com 2002 '4dr Sdn WRX Manual': "Base Curb Weight 3,085 lbs" (cars-com-wrx-2002); 2003: "3,090 lbs" (cars-com-wrx-2003). Grassroots Motorsports (unsigned) gives 'a curb weight of 3085 pounds' in its text but 'Weight: 3140 pounds' in its spec list (grassroots-wrx-2002). No Subaru curb weight was found.

A Subaru curb weight (2002 press kit or brochure), a major magazine spec panel or a second named-author outlet would replace it. Power is from Subaru's release.
